bias: For tabulated transport_points, use bias_V=(mu_left_eV-mu_right_eV) in electron-volt/elementary-charge units. Convert other laboratory sign conventions explicitly.
current: Record signed current in A, its laboratory direction and uncertainty. Other units may be used in quantitative_observations with stated dimensions.
rectification: Define your measure, bias and direction explicitly. Inverse or alternative scientifically valid conventions are allowed when their relationship to the reported currents is auditable. Undefined ratios must be reported as bounds or unresolved, not assigned a finite value.
reference: All chemical potentials and transmission-energy axes must share the documented zero for the same object.
comparability: Which calculations can be compared is a scientific claim needing justification; no fixed perturbation is prescribed.
